data.description:
# Intake Brief — test runner changed-scope selects DELETED test files

## Problem statement

The skill test runner's changed-scope selector (`map_changed_to_tests()` in `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py`) adds every changed file whose name matches test-file conventions to the pytest selection **without checking that the path still exists on disk**. When an implementation deletes or renames a test file, the selector emits a `pytest ... <deleted-file>` command; pytest exits 4 ("file or directory not found"), and `implement.py finish` aborts its changed-scope gate with "Test run failed", forcing an `IMPLEMENT_TEST_COMMAND` full-scope override.

## Users

Agent/developer running `/skill:implement` on a work item that removes or renames a test file (e.g. decommissioning a module and its tests). Proxy operators depend on the same gate to keep the dev branch green.

- As an implementing agent, I want the changed-scope selector to ignore test files I deleted or renamed, so that `implement.py finish` proceeds to the full-suite gate instead of prompting me to fix a phantom test failure.
- As an operator, I want a partially or fully deleted test selection to fall back to the full suite, so testing is never silently skipped and commits stay gated.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: `map_changed_to_tests()` excludes any changed path that no longer exists on disk; a deleted `tests/test_foo.py` (present in `git diff --name-only` but absent from the worktree) must not appear in the returned selection. Existing changed test files that still exist remain selected (no regression).
- AC2: `changed_scope_commands()` never emits a command that references a non-existent path. When filtering leaves the selection empty (e.g. the only change is a deleted test file), it returns `None` so the caller falls back to the **full** suite rather than producing a pytest command that exits 4 (no silent skip).
- AC3: A regression test reproduces the original scenario — a worktree with one deleted test file plus one modified source/test file — and asserts the emitted changed-scope command contains only existing paths (and no deleted path). A companion `implement.py` test asserts the changed-scope gate no longer reports "Test run failed" when the selection is a deletion-only change (defensive handling of a pytest "no tests / file not found" exit code as a full-scope fallback).
- AC4: All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries (specifically `skill/test/SKILL.md` and any reference doc describing changed-scope selection: deleted/non-existent paths are excluded, and an all-deleted selection falls back to full scope).
- AC5: Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Repository boundary:** the fix lives in agent-infrastructure code in the **SorraAgents** repo (`skill/test/`, `skill/implement/`), not the `llm` repo. `~/.pi/agent/skills/test` is a symlink to `SorraAgents/skill/test`; the installed runner has no copy in `llm`. The implementation worktree must be created in the SorraAgents repo (precedent: LP-0MSQ32HNR007AI6B, committed there as `3d12a17f`).
- Must not silently skip testing: an empty selection after filtering must fall back to full scope, never return a bare/empty command.
- Preserve existing selection semantics: convention mapping, package-`__init__` expansion and import-graph expansion are unchanged for files that still exist.
- Keep the changed-scope cache key/scope metadata semantics (`scope: "changed"`) intact; a fallback run is a full-suite run (`scope: "full"`).
- No new runtime dependency.

## Existing state

Root cause (confirmed by reading the source):

- `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` `map_changed_to_tests()` (convention mapping, ~L297–299):
  ```python
  if _is_test_file(rel):
      selected.add(changed_file)
      continue
  ```
  This adds the changed path unconditionally, with no `(root / changed_file).exists()` guard.
- `changed_scope_commands()` (~L465–530) consumes `selected` and emits `pytest <file_args>` / `node --test <file_args>` without any existence filter, so a deleted path reaches the command line.
- `skill/implement/scripts/implement.py` `_run_changed_scope_pytest()` (~L1498) takes the first `pytest` command from `_changed_scope_commands()`, runs it, and treats a non-zero exit as a failure; `run_tests()` (~L1524) only falls back to full scope when `_changed_scope_commands()` returns falsy. pytest exit 4 (usage error / no tests collected for a missing path) is therefore reported as "Test run failed".

Repro (from the description): work item LP-0MTZRM5HV0007S0V deleted `proxy/tests/test_slot_scheduler.py`; the built command was `pytest -q ... <modified test files...> proxy/tests/test_slot_scheduler.py`, which no longer exists → exit 4 → gate abort.

Existing tests: `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py` (`TestMapChangedToTests`, `TestChangedScopeCommands`) and `tests/test_implement_run_tests_scope.py`.

## Desired change

1. In `map_changed_to_tests()`: only add a changed test file when `(root / changed_file).exists()`; skip deleted/non-existent paths (log/annotate at debug level is optional).
2. Add a final existence filter over the `selected` set before it is consumed (covers convention-mapped and import-graph entries as well as direct test-file entries).
3. In `changed_scope_commands()`: filter `selected` to existing files; if the filtered set is empty, return `None` (full-scope fallback), never an empty/degenerate command.
4. Defensive guard in `implement.py`: treat a changed-scope pytest run that fails only because no valid tests were collected / the path is missing (pytest exit code 4) as "selection unavailable" → fall back to full scope, distinct from a genuine test failure (exit code 1). This keeps the gate fail-closed (full suite still runs) while removing the phantom-failure abort.
5. Tests covering deleted-file exclusion, mixed deleted+modified selection, and the implement gate behavior for a deletion-only change.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` — `map_changed_to_tests()` (~L240–330) add existence guard; `changed_scope_commands()` (~L465–530) filter selection and fall back to full scope when empty.
- `skill/test/tests/test_run_tests_scope.py` — new regression tests in `TestMapChangedToTests` / `TestChangedScopeCommands` for deleted and non-existent paths.
- `skill/implement/scripts/implement.py` — `_run_changed_scope_pytest()` (~L1498) / `run_tests()` (~L1524) defensive exit-code-4 fallback to full scope.
- `tests/test_implement_run_tests_scope.py` — implement-level test that a deletion-only change no longer aborts the changed-scope gate.
- `skill/test/SKILL.md` — document the exclusion + full-scope fallback behavior for deleted/non-existent test paths.

## Related work

- LP-0MTZRM5HV0007S0V (discovered-from) — "Simplify slot config…"; deleted `proxy/tests/test_slot_scheduler.py`, which triggered this bug.
- LP-0MTZZLHYB003OEIJ (sibling follow-up) — "audit runner: cq scan widens to whole repo…".
- LP-0MTZUZR7K009Q98J (sibling follow-up) — "proxy-usage-analysis: drop slot_schedule dependency…".
- LP-0MSQ32HNR007AI6B (precedent) — LP-prefixed work item tracked in the llm worklog but implemented in the SorraAgents repo (`skill/audit/`), commit `3d12a17f`.

## Assumptions

- The owning worklog for this item is the `llm` worklog (LP prefix), while the code change is made in the SorraAgents repo — consistent with prior agent-infrastructure items (e.g. LP-0MSQ32HNR007AI6B).
- "Non-existent paths" means paths absent from the checked-out worktree at selection time (deleted or renamed-away files); untracked files are already excluded by `compute_changed_files()`.
- A deletion-only change should still run the full suite (fail-closed), not skip testing.

## Risks

- Over-filtering could mask a genuinely deleted test that another existing test still needs; mitigated by the full-suite fallback.
- Exit-code-4 special-casing must not swallow real collection errors in existing files (e.g. a syntax error causing a usage error); scope the guard to the "no valid paths" case and keep exit code 1 as a hard failure.
- Scope creep: broader "changed-scope selection correctness" improvements (e.g. deleted source modules) are out of scope; record as follow-up work items if discovered.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions and answers

No clarifying questions were required. The seed context (problem, root cause with file/function references, expected behavior, impact, repro, and files) was complete and independently verified against `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` and `skill/implement/scripts/implement.py`; the only non-obvious point — the owning repo/worklog split — is documented in **Assumptions** and matches established precedent (LP-0MSQ32HNR007AI6B).
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **LP-0MS9NZBEY009XOU8** – [test-failure] tests/test_version_footer.py::test_index_template_shows_unknown_when_not_captured — failing test (completed)
- **LP-0MRB2A55L00400XF** – Bug: Default Guardrail Runtime Cutoff Too Long (1800s / 30 Minutes) (completed)
- **LP-0MSUDM1DZ006VVSJ** – [HIGH] /home/rgardler/projects/llm/skill/cleanup/scripts/lib.py:22 — Module level import not at top of file (E402) (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — matched: aborts, add, adds, agent, also (+72 more)
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — matched: aborts, add, adds, agent, also (+68 more)
- `skill/implement/scripts/implement.py` — matched: add, agent, also, always, cannot (+61 more)
